title: MEIKO — Necessary Distance〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyways, I should head back and find Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO? Are you alone...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, someone else was here...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Mizuki was...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Mizuki was looking for Mafuyu, but left after I said she wasn't here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is something bothering you, MEIKO...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes...
It seems like there's something else on Mizuki's mind.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That reminds me, you said you were interested in how the four of them were feeling.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. Those three can freely enter and exit this SEKAI as well, even though it's based on Mafuyu's thoughts and feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Those three must mean just that much to her. So much that she can't be without them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's sort of why I said that I'd like to observe and watch for the time being.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I understand that, but what is it that you're hoping to learn about them...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What they want to do and why, I think...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What they want to do and why?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Mafuyu has slowly begun to change since she discovered what her true feelings are. Am I right, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And the other three, Kanade, Ena and Mizuki, were the ones that helped open that door for her...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Mafuyu meeting them has caused this SEKAI to slowly change.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Enough to make Rin and myself appear.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
I came here when Ena needed help.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, does this mean someone else needs our help again?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's very likely.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Very likely...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm not certain as to why I'm here or what I'm supposed to do...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And you want to learn what they want to do and why to figure that out...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When Rin first came here, she also seemed somewhat lost and wasn't sure what she should be doing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She's right.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How did you get through it...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh? I... I met Miku and talked to her...
And I talked to Kanade and the others...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You seem doubtful...
I'm telling the truth.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Things may not be as clear as you'd like yet because Mafuyu may still have a few questions that haven't been answered.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Maybe...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (No, it's too soon to draw out any conclusions. I still need more information...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I need to keep observing them...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Um, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I understand why you're keeping Kanade and the others at arm's length, but are you planning on doing that with us too?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What would you like me to do, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean... Nevermind...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think Rin wants to sing with you, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She does...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When you said that you plan to keep your distance from everyone...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That ended up including us too, and she seemed a little sad about losing the chance to sing with you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I haven't heard the song that was born out of Mafuyu's true feelings yet.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As part of my observations, I should listen to... No, sing it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If that's what you want to do, fine.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's all sing together, Rin, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay.
